lines: - Fix #8623: Secrets from `.env` (e.g. `HUMHUB_CONFIG__*` passwords, keys, tokens, DSNs) were written in plain text to `app.log` and the `logging` table via the `$_SERVER` dump; values are now masked by key name (PASS, SECRET, KEY, TOKEN, DSN, AUTH, COOKIE, ...)
- Fix #8624: Stored XSS via the user display name in the friendship confirmation dialog
- Fix #8627: The full-size profile image overlay now closes on the browser Back button instead of staying open over the previous page

+- Fix #8638: The default Content-Security-Policy blocked fonts embedded as `data:` URIs (e.g. the icon font of the Calendar module), which logged a violation in the browser console; `data:` is now allowed in `font-src`

- Fix #8639: Dates containing non-ASCII characters (e.g. the `fa-IR` and `ar` locales) were rejected as invalid on PHP 8.4+, because `IntlDateFormatter::parse()` now returns the position in bytes while Yii compares it with the character count

-                    "Content-Security-Policy" => "default-src *; connect-src  *; font-src 'self' https://* http://* *; frame-src https://* http://* *; img-src https://* http://* * data:; object-src 'self'; script-src {{ nonce }} 'self' https://* http://* * 'unsafe-inline' 'report-sample'; style-src * https://* http://* * 'unsafe-inline'; block-all-mixed-content;",

+                    "Content-Security-Policy" => "default-src *; connect-src  *; font-src 'self' data: https://* http://* *; frame-src https://* http://* *; img-src https://* http://* * data:; object-src 'self'; script-src {{ nonce }} 'self' https://* http://* * 'unsafe-inline' 'report-sample'; style-src * https://* http://* * 'unsafe-inline'; block-all-mixed-content;",
